title.en: Types of solutions and expressing concentration

hook.en: Saline drips, ORS and the fuel in a vehicle all depend on getting the concentration exactly right.
hook.kn: ಸಲೈನ್, ORS ಮತ್ತು ಇಂಧನ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಸಾರತೆಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿವೆ.

narration.en: Saline drips, ORS and the fuel in a vehicle all depend on getting the concentration exactly right.
narration.kn: ಸಲೈನ್, ORS ಮತ್ತು ಇಂಧನ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಸಾರತೆಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿವೆ.

body.en: A solution is a homogeneous mixture. The component present in the largest amount is the solvent; the others are solutes. Solutions can be gaseous, liquid or solid (air, sugar in water, brass).
body.kn: ದ್ರಾವಣ ಎಂದರೆ ಏಕರೂಪ ಮಿಶ್ರಣ. ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿರುವುದು ದ್ರಾವಕ, ಉಳಿದವು ದ್ರಾವ್ಯಗಳು.

narration.en: A solution is a homogeneous mixture. The component present in the largest amount is the solvent; the others are solutes. Solutions can be gaseous, liquid or solid (air, sugar in water, brass).
narration.kn: ದ್ರಾವಣ ಎಂದರೆ ಏಕರೂಪ ಮಿಶ್ರಣ. ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿರುವುದು ದ್ರಾವಕ, ಉಳಿದವು ದ್ರಾವ್ಯಗಳು.

caption.en: Water is a polar molecule, which is why it dissolves ionic and polar solutes so well.

narration.en: Water is a polar molecule, which is why it dissolves ionic and polar solutes so well.

body.en: Mass %, ppm, mole fraction $x$, molarity $M$ (mol per litre of solution) and molality $m$ (mol per kg of solvent). Molality and mole fraction do not change with temperature; molarity does.
body.kn: ಮೋಲಾರಿಟಿ = ಒಂದು ಲೀಟರ್ ದ್ರಾವಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೋಲ್‌ಗಳು. ಮೋಲಾಲಿಟಿ = ಒಂದು ಕಿ.ಗ್ರಾಂ ದ್ರಾವಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೋಲ್‌ಗಳು.

narration.en: Mass %, ppm, mole fraction $x$, molarity $M$ (mol per litre of solution) and molality $m$ (mol per kg of solvent). Molality and mole fraction do not change with temperature; molarity does.
narration.kn: ಮೋಲಾರಿಟಿ = ಒಂದು ಲೀಟರ್ ದ್ರಾವಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೋಲ್‌ಗಳು. ಮೋಲಾಲಿಟಿ = ಒಂದು ಕಿ.ಗ್ರಾಂ ದ್ರಾವಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೋಲ್‌ಗಳು.

caption.en: Change the amount of solute and the volume of solution and watch the molarity change.

tryThis.en: Add water: moles stay the same, molarity falls.
Fill to saturation: no more solute dissolves.

narration.en: Change the amount of solute and the volume of solution and watch the molarity change. Add water: moles stay the same, molarity falls. Fill to saturation: no more solute dissolves.

aim.en: Find the molarity of a sodium hydroxide solution by titrating it against 0.05 M oxalic acid.

narration.en: Virtual lab. Aim: Find the molarity of a sodium hydroxide solution by titrating it against 0.05 M oxalic acid.

problem.en: 4 g NaOH is dissolved to make 250 mL of solution. Find the molarity.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. 4 g NaOH is dissolved to make 250 mL of solution. Find the molarity.

body.en: molaRity → litRe of solution; molaLity → kiLogram of soLvent. Temperature changes volume, so only molarity changes.

narration.en: Molarity vs molality. molaRity → litRe of solution; molaLity → kiLogram of soLvent. Temperature changes volume, so only molarity changes.

narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: Molarity uses litres of solution; molality uses kg of solvent.
points.kn: ಮೋಲಾರಿಟಿ: ಲೀಟರ್ ದ್ರಾವಣ; ಮೋಲಾಲಿಟಿ: ಕಿ.ಗ್ರಾಂ ದ್ರಾವಕ.

points.en: Molality and mole fraction do not depend on temperature.

narration.en: Recap. Molarity uses litres of solution; molality uses kg of solvent. Molality and mole fraction do not depend on temperature. x_A + x_B = 1.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಮೋಲಾರಿಟಿ: ಲೀಟರ್ ದ್ರಾವಣ; ಮೋಲಾಲಿಟಿ: ಕಿ.ಗ್ರಾಂ ದ್ರಾವಕ. ಮೋಲಾಲಿಟಿ ತಾಪಮಾನವನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. x_A + x_B = 1.
